Knowing the value of what you eat is the true meaning of food and eating. Knowing the value of what you eat is the true meaning of food and eating. Learn how your favourite dishes came to be by discovering the origins of daily ingredients by stepping into farms, seas, rivers and food processing plants. Besides exploring the relationship between food and their origins, the processes, environments, and even the weather, also listen to the beliefs of the producers and the recommended cooking methods before presenting the delicious meals.

programme.title: Batie Girl
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.desc: This film focuses on ordinary Chinese people of different regions and identities. programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology- While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seem–from slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Popular Athens Recipes
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Greek Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Hearty Greek Fare
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: Leaves and Lettuces
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: This video delves into the passionate and tumultuous journey of a small-town romance, capturing the essence of youthful love and heartbreak. The Giant Pig Smokehouse, a beloved local barbecue spot, serves as a backdrop for heartfelt conversations between friends and patrons who share their thoughts on love, loss, and moving forward. Owners Melissa and her brother opened the establishment in 2019, inspired by their love for smoked foods and Southern barbecue traditions. The video showcases their dedication to serving flavorful, family-style meals, emphasizing the importance of patience and love in their cooking.nnViewers will hear from various patrons, each with their own story of love and heartache. From a couple reminiscing about their high school days to a person reflecting on a past relationship, the narratives highlight the universal themes of longing, regret, and the hope for new beginnings. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is more than just a restaurant; it’s a community hub where stories unfold and lives intersect. Whether it's the long lines for their famous pulled pork or the creation of a special menu item due to a customer's misreading, the video paints a vivid picture of a place that nurtures connections and memories. Join us as we explore how love, in all its forms, shapes the experiences of those who walk through its doors.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: As warfare has evolved, many military techniques and technologies have been adapted for use in urban settings by police units around the world. This episode provides viewers with an intimate perspective on what it feels like to be "inside the heads" of special police personnel, and how their use of military-style strategies and equipment allows them to save lives. From riot control in South Africa and the lessons learned from its excesses, to Los Angeles Police Chief Robert Gates’ creation of an elite police S.W.A.T team, CQB will showcase how, over the past 30 years, the fight against urban crime has evolved into a military scenario, with both sides using increasingly complex weaponry and tactics.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: "Special Operations" are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: As warfare has evolved, many military techniques and technologies have been adapted for use in urban settings by police units around the world. This episode provides viewers with an intimate perspective on what it feels like to be "inside the heads" of special police personnel, and how their use of military-style strategies and equipment allows them to save lives. From riot control in South Africa and the lessons learned from its excesses, to Los Angeles Police Chief Robert Gates’ creation of an elite police S.W.A.T team, CQB will showcase how, over the past 30 years, the fight against urban crime has evolved into a military scenario, with both sides using increasingly complex weaponry and tactics.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. programme.desc: Astronomers linked radio dishes around the world to create the "Event Horizon Telescope" and have utilized this tool to photograph a supermassive black hole in the heart of our own Milky Way Galaxy. programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here

The sky above is littered with stars and countless galaxies. The next stage of our journey is with robotics, advanced technologies and sheer daring we are now going where before we only dreamt.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E02 - Return To The Moon
programme.desc: The Moon, our closest celestial companion. Our indispensible dance partner through the cosmos. Lighting our night sky and gently tugging at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with reThe Newed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between us and our Star, the inner worlds; hidden within the sun's glare often only visible at sunrise or sunset. Venus the first and brightest star in the evening sky, and Mercury fleeting across the solar disk. They are half of our solar system's terrestrial planets and yet as we look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E04 - Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E04 - Badge Bust and Beluga Whale
programme.desc: In 'Badge Bust,' one badge's over confidence gets another badge in trouble. Meanwhile, 'Beluga Whale' tells the story of a sea creature far from home that's quite the adventure.

programme.desc: While hiking alone deep in Glacier National Park, Ted Porter plummets into an icy glacial crevasse. With a broken back and miles from anyone, he must fight to survive.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: After the fall of the soviet union many countries remained in dispute in the early nineties despite eastern Europe‘s independence. In 1994 a bitter conflict broke out between the forces of the Chechen independence movement and the Russian regular army. Despite overwhelming manpower, weaponry and air support, the Russian forces were unable to establish effective permanent control over the mountainous area due to many successful Chechen guerrilla raids. Improvised Explosive Devices were one of the most effective methods employed in these disastrous raids and were the back drop to many Close Quarter Battle scenarios exchanged between the two sides.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: The history of the British Empire colonial legacy in Northern Ireland is well known the world over but a there is a largely untold story of the the firefights between and close quarter battles exchanged between the provisional IRA, the British army and the elite SAS. Although the IRA often employed „terrorist" techniques within the city of London and on England‘s mainland not much is said of the often guerilla warfare techniques of the British Special Air Service in Northern Ireland since the beginning of this conflict. In this episode we will examine how the history of the Special Air Service affected the training of every elite force after it and how the close quarter battles in Northern Ireland in the late 1970s through to the millennium shaped both special forces and resistance methods.

In this episode we will examine how the history of the Special Air Service affected the training of every elite force after it and how the close quarter battles in Northern Ireland in the late 1970s through to the millennium shaped both special forces and resistance methods.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare
programme.desc: A father and son camping trip turns into a desperate fight to survive when John Sloot is crushed under an ATV. Now his 10 year-old son, Cody must brave the wilderness alone to get help.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: After the fall of the soviet union many countries remained in dispute in the early nineties despite eastern Europe‘s independence. In 1994 a bitter conflict broke out between the forces of the Chechen independence movement and the Russian regular army. Despite overwhelming manpower, weaponry and air support, the Russian forces were unable to establish effective permanent control over the mountainous area due to many successful Chechen guerrilla raids. Improvised Explosive Devices were one of the most effective methods employed in these disastrous raids and were the back drop to many Close Quarter Battle scenarios exchanged between the two sides.

programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. programme.desc: Game Wardens take on one of the biggest cases ever in Ohio's Division of Wildlife's 146-year history. They must figure out what happened when a bunch of people break the law. In "Seat Belt," a routine traffic stop leads to a surprising find.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E06 - Lobster Poaching and Black Walnut
programme.desc: In "Lobster Poaching," a poacher has a bad day by jumping into the wrong boat. Meanwhile, "Black Walnut" tells a story about a surprising species that catches a Game Warden's attention. Game Wardens reminisce about unforgettable cases and experiences from their jobs.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Hunters Adrian Knopps and Garrett Hagen venture into the remotest part of Alaska's Misty Fjord, hunting Moose and Bear. After a successful hunt Adrian finds himself trapped by a twenty foot tidal surge after Garrett fails to return with the skiff.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: After a successful hunt., Adrian Knopps' hunting partner disappears taking their bear out to the boat. Now Adrian finds himself stranded on a tidal flat surround by bears and wolf packs and with massive storm bearing down on him. How will he survive?

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the "sub-second" reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 "Little Bird" helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at "the sharp end of the spear." A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.

programme.desc: By 2100 over 1 billion people on Earth will live in low-lying coastal zones. 70% of these will live in Southeast Asia, one of the most vulnerable regions in the world to climate change. The next decade will be the most critical for the future existence of these societies.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E04 - Food Security
programme.desc: Rice, it's a staple food for many in Asia. It provides 1/3 of the energy in the average Asian diet and is the income source for more than 500 million people. programme.desc: Natural hazards remain a constant challenge for over 400 million people who live in low lying communities built along major mega delta regions in coastal zones. Events like typhoons and tsunamis threaten their very survival.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E03 - Volcanic Field Lab
programme.desc: Many people now know that climate change is real, that they see the data or they see the observations for themselves. What's needed now is a sense of urgency. We have within the next decade exceedingly important decisions to make.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E04 - Food Security
programme.desc: Rice, it's a staple food for many in Asia. It provides 1/3 of the energy in the average Asian diet and is the income source for more than 500 million people. So, what is the future of our staple foods like rice? And how do we address the uncertainty that we face in these changing times?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E59 - Saving the Right Whale
programme.desc: The North Atlantic Right Whale is on the verge of extinction. The leading cause of death and injury to the whales is from ship strikes or entanglement in fishing lines. In this Breakthrough episode, we will hear from the leading experts and biologists who are racing to save this species.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E64 - Super Spider Silk
programme.desc: From their unique predatory behaviours to the web masterpieces they weave, science is revealing big breakthroughs about spiders and their super strong and flexible silks.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E06 - Saber-Tooth Brawl
programme.desc: Lions may be known as the kings of the jungle, but it was saber-tooth cats that ruled over the Americas. New fossil evidence is shinning a light on the violent lives of these mysterious species.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E83 - The Great Seaweed Invasion
programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean!

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E00 - Reefs Of Hope Extended Version
programme.desc: With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E04 - Aggressive Measures
programme.desc: Ivan goes to Mozambique to join an anti-poaching team that focuses on catching poachers and protecting at-risk animals.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E05 - Extreme Conditions
programme.desc: Conservationists capture and study Whitetail Deer in the frigid South Dakotan winter.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E06 - Capturing the Wild
programme.desc: Conservationists employ sophisticated tactics to capture kudu, impala, and giraffe.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E07 - Little Big Solutions
programme.desc: Quail and their habitat are studied in Texas.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E08 - Legacy
programme.desc: A family of conservationists capture and study elephants in Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E18 - Resurrecting Tasmanian Tigers
programme.desc: Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on resurrecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E44 - 50 Glorious Years A Royal Celebration

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: In what is regarded as one of greatest survival stories of the 20th Century, sailor Steven Callahan finds himself alone and adrift in a life raft after his boat, the Napoleon Solo sinks in the mid Atlantic.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E10 - Adrift Part 2
programme.desc: Facing starvation, dehydration and predators from the deep, sailor Steven Callahan fights to survive not only the physical hardships, but also the mental and emotional strain of being adrift and alone in a disintegrating life raft.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E07 - S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: In 1968, a new form of military policing was being developed in a rural area north of Los Angeles. The Los Angeles Police Department sent an observer to this unit, and he, in turn, took this knowledge back to the LAPD. This contributed to the development of the department’s first Special Weapons and Tactics (S.W.A.T.) team. This CQB episode takes an historical journey to examine how this incident affected and changed police tactics around the world. Using CQB’s trademark "sub-second" analysis, the program also looks at how police S.W.A.T. teams train, plan and equip themselves for the challenges of urban combat. The dramatization of a 1980s S.W.A.T. siege of a gang safe-house demonstrates the complicated challenge of protecting innocent people who might be caught in the line of fi re, as well as the specifics of the squad’s training regimen, how they communicated, and the special equipment they used.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: The Bosnian War was an extraordinarily complex event, with many layers of military involvement including NATO forces, national militaries, irregular paramilitary forces, mujahedeen revolutionaries, private security companies, and international intelligence personnel. One tactic in particular struck fear into the hearts of the military and civilians alike: the use of snipers positioned in high buildings. This edition of CQB investigates this specific combat technique and how it was countered by opposing forces. Taking viewers inside a "sniper‘s den," the program explains how this tactic was so successfully used by rebel forces – and how traditional military techniques evolved to combat it.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: The practice of hiring private armies goes back to ancient times, and the mystique associated with the mercenary warrior has been the subject of many historical studies and fictional characterizations. This episode of CQB takes a more contemporary look at a day in the life of a group of civilian contractors, and how their role has evolved on the modern battlefield. Using its "sub-second" analysis techniques and intimate first-person footage, CQB reveals the backgrounds, training and equipment of today’s "soldiers for hire" and how private armies are re-shaping the way conflicts are conducted around the world.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: From the elite ex-special forces personnel in charge of guarding heads of state in conflict zones to the two-person teams that protect CEOs in dangerous regions, modern day bodyguards must be well versed in close quarter battle techniques. An immense amount of planning and preparation is involved in each operation. From air travel, car convoys and helicopter shuttles to basic foot traffic, a close protection squad must be completely tuned to the Who, What, Where and When of any given situation. This episode of CQB focuses on the complex day-to-day and minute-to-minute operations of these elite teams and the highly developed techniques they employ.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, was incredibly enchanting and unforgettable, leaving a lasting impact like no other woman of her era. Florencia ofrece a Hilario una nueva manera de hacer que los Alcoy pierdan dinero, pero ésta vez quiere una parte del dinero que Guanipa va a ganar en el negocio. A pesar de estar enfrentados y llenos de rabia; Nicolás y Victoria se dejan llevar por sus sentimientos y se besan con pasión sin poder evitarlo.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E047
programme.desc: Federico está decidido a conseguir la gente suficiente para invadir Cantarrana para que a Hilario no le quede más remedio que vendérsela a su familia a pesar de que Bautista no lo considera capaz de lograr algo así. Leopoldo, que le reitera a Nicolás lo orgulloso que se encuentra de él, lamenta que no haya podido conseguir lo que quería con Victoria; Nicolás cree que, aunque no pueda ser feliz al lado de la mujer que ama, por lo menos va a tratar de demostrarle que él no es el delincuente que ella piensa. Nicolás no llega a salir con Moncho como pretende porque Joselo lo ataca por la espalda dejándolo sin sentido; ambos hombres deciden llevar a Del Casal ante Hilario. Federico se encuentra a Clementina en el camino y no duda en apuntarla con su arma para obligarla a acompañarlo porque no quiere que nadie sepa que él anda por ahí. Hilario llama a Fernanda para advertirle que tiene a Federico y que está dispuesto a entregárselo una vez que ella le devuelva el ganado que le robaron por órdenes suyas; de lo contrario, no responde por la suerte del muchacho.

He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: A family of strict parents and siblings who don’t get along with each other. After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky, Ramunah and their friends takes on the mission to save their parents after training hard for it.. Everything goes almost swimmingly, if not because of the three stooges, and along the way, Sky and Ramunah discover that their parents have been caring about them all along, but unfortunately, the kids failed the last task and they lost their parents to the limbo.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Drama class. Cikgu Lakshmi teaches the students acting and the art of theatre. They put on a very bad show. The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students pull a prank on Wan Yunus, the gullible new student from Kelantan. They tell him that his crush, Florence, likes him but she is too shy to tell him. They lie to him about what Florence likes and gets him to dress silly, do silly things, and say silly things to her. He ends up embarrassing himself. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. They teach him all the basics like ordering food at a mamak restaurant, the salutations such as "macha", "brader" (not ‘brother’), "boss", etc. Wan Yunus teaches him how to flirt in Kelantanese dialect. In the end, he uses his knowledge to impress Cikgu Joji and takes her out on a date.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Malaysia Day. Class decoration competition lead by Gowri. They excel in the competition, winning first place. However, before they can receive the grand prize the judge, principal Puan Aida, asks them what exactly is Malaysia Day. None of the students can answer (even James Blond). The whole class is punished. Cikgu Joji educates them on Malaysia Day while all of them stand on their chairs.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: A family of strict parents and siblings who don’t get along with each other. After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky, Ramunah and their friends takes on the mission to save their parents after training hard for it.. Everything goes almost swimmingly, if not because of the three stooges, and along the way, Sky and Ramunah discover that their parents have been caring about them all along, but unfortunately, the kids failed the last task and they lost their parents to the limbo.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis
programme.desc: Kris bertegas untuk meneruskan majlis perkahwinan walaupun masing-masing baru kehilangan orang tersayang. Namun keadaan menjadi kecoh apabila baju pengantin Kris terlalu besar dan hodoh hingga melewatkan majlis nikah.

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis
programme.desc: Keadaan di ladang semakin sukar sejak ketiadaan Kris, Pak Ali dan Tok Abah. Demi amanat Tok Abah, Salsabilaberusaha keras untuk menyelamatkan ladang.

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis
programme.desc: Salsabila hairan apabila Cik Su mampu untuk membayar tunggakan gaji pekerja. Kemunculan semula Kris telahmengejutkan seluruh warga ladang dan keluarganya.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E13 - Rooney, England, Charlton, Three Lions, Manchester United, Ballon d'Or
programme.desc: Bobby Charlton. One of England’s many heroes of 1966. A man who overcame so much to achieve great things. While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E02 - Tiger Woods, Arnold Palmer

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E17 - Martina Navratilova, Novak Djokovic, Rod Laver
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds, we salute the superstars of tennis, celebrating the off court bravery of Martina Navratilova, the relentless winning of Novak Djokovic, and the all round greatness of the man who ushered in the modern professional era, Rod Laver.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E26 - Jose Mourinho, Bert Trautmann
programme.desc: This time on Against the Odds . . . the Special One, Jose Mourinho, who has managed many of the best clubs in football and won trophies wherever he’s gone, and one of Manchester City’s all-time greats, goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, and his courageous performance in the 1956 FA Cup Final.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E15 - Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost
programme.desc: They were the key players in a golden era of Formula One, the fascinatingly flawed Brazilian genius Ayrton Senna and his great rival, the meticulous Frenchman Alain Prost.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E22 - Johan Cruyff, Neymar

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E30 - Leicester City FC, US Women’s National Soccer Team, Iceland
programme.desc: Leicester City were almost relegated in their first year back in England’s Premier League, the next year they won the entire competition. Megan Rapinoe and the US Women’s National Soccer Team took on prominent social issues while taking on the world’s best teams. Iceland were the smallest county to ever qualify for a major finals and ended up beating one of the giants of international football.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E27 - Luka Modric, Lucy Bronze, George Best
programme.desc: Luka Modrić rose out of abject poverty during the Croatian War of Independence to become his nation’s greatest player.Lucy Bronze emerged from the solitude of the Holy Island of Lindisfarne to become England’s most decorated Lioness.And George Best grew up on the streets of troubled Belfast to become the footballer every Irishman loved.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E13 - Christiano Ronaldo, Zinedine Zidane, Eusebio
